title: riglab.hold v1
description: Where a weapon's free bodies first sit when the rig, standing at rest, takes it (src/format/hold.ts, validateHold), in rest-pose coordinates carried with the torso. Rules this schema cannot express, which a reader must check against the weapon: `name` is the weapon's name; `bodies` places each of the weapon's free bodies (those with two grips) exactly once, and no body that rides a hand.

name.description: 1-64 letters, digits, '_' or '-', starting with a letter.

body-placement.description: A free body's origin and its rotation in degrees.
